subject: MSA & Order Form: proposed audit window and temporary console access for on-prem deployment
messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@medsys.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form - scheduling audit window for on-prem deployment

Hi Rishi / Monica,

Thanks for the context on the private deployment. Procurement and our infra team have a couple of quick questions so we can schedule a vendor-led security audit before contract signature:

- Preferred audit window: we need a two-day window (read-only) to review logs, ACLs, and configuration. Do you have a week in September that works?
- Console access: can Redwood provide temporary, timeboxed read-only console credentials (or a jumpbox session) scoped to the deployment?
- Evidence delivery: we prefer a secure portal where artifacts (logs, configs) can be uploaded. Do you have a link or SFTP details?
- Licensing scope: legal asked if the MSA addendum can explicitly separate "deployment rights" (what we can run) from "operator access" (who can log into runtime).

I attached an initial audit scope spreadsheet for your intake. If we can confirm the window and portal details this week we’ll get the PO in flight.

Regards,
Sophie Grant
Security & Compliance Lead
Medsys Health

Attachments: initial_audit_scope.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@medsys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form - scheduling audit window for on-prem deployment

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below:

- Audit window: proposed weeks we can support vendor access (read-only): week of 2026-09-21 or week of 2026-09-28. Please let us know preferred dates and your timezone for coordination.
- Temporary access: we can provision timebound read-only tokens via our Ops console and create a restricted service account for vendor review. Access will be logged and limited to the specific cluster/VMs in scope. We will not provide write or ssh root access.
- Evidence portal: we use a Secure Evidence Portal (internal drive link below). We can create a Medsys tenant and a dedicated folder for uploads; files will inherit RBAC and retention controls.
- MSA addendum / license scope: legal/finance asked us to propose a narrow clause that distinguishes "deployment rights" from "operator access" and includes timeboxed audit tokens and an obligation to notify Redwood of any persistent access beyond the window. I’ve uploaded a redlined MSA outline for legal to review.

Next actions I propose:
1) Monica to coordinate internal legal redlines and confirm the specific clause language we can accept.
2) Karthik (infra) to prepare the access profile and identify a single infra contact.
3) Sophie to confirm preferred audit dates and whether procurement needs a PO before we lock the window.

Links: Secure Evidence Portal - https://drive.redwood.ai/secure/evidence/medsys-2026-audit
DocuSign stub for Order Form - https://docusign.com/redsigned/medsys-4721

I’ve attached our draft redlines for the MSA addendum.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Enterprise Sales (Private Deployments)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_msa_20260901.docx

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Grant <sophie@medsys.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 15:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form - scheduling audit window for on-prem deployment

Thanks Rishi — looping legal and infra notes. A few points from our side to keep this clean for contracting:

- Legal preference: split the addendum into two short clauses — (A) "License & Deployment Rights" (what the customer is licensed to run and the territory) and (B) "Operator Access & Audit" (temporal, scoped access for audits with logging obligations). This reduces ambiguity during renewal.
- Access control: we will only approve "audit-only" read tokens; they must be scoped and expire automatically. We want the audit report to be shared via the Secure Evidence Portal, not emailed.
- Escalation and remediation: include an SLA for Redwood to address any infra findings that indicate a critical misconfiguration discovered during the audit (48 hour remediation acknowledgement).
- PO and Order Form: procurement typically wants the PO before we allocate dedicated infra. If Medsys can confirm the PO timeline we’ll reserve capacity for the chosen week.

Karthik — can you draft the exact IAM policy (least privilege) for the vendor and the infra contact who will stand up the read-only session? I’ll convert our legal notes into concrete redline language and push to Sophie/Procurement.

Monica Patel
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Grant <sophie@medsys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form - scheduling audit window for on-prem deployment

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Procurement confirmed we can do week of 2026-09-21 (targeting Tue/Wed). PO team will start a purchase request once we sign the Order Form.

We agree to the Secure Evidence Portal and timeboxed read-only tokens. We’ll accept an SLA acknowledgement for remediation (48 hours) in the addendum; legal will still want to review the exact phrasing but this is a good start.

Attached: vendor_audit_req.pdf (procurement checklist). Procurement contact is procurement@medsys.com — they’ll reach out separately with PO timing.

Next steps for Redwood:
- Monica to send redlined clause language for both License & Deployment Rights and Operator Access & Audit.
- Karthik to draft the IAM/read-only token policy and confirm the infra contact details.
- Rishi to provision the Secure Evidence Portal folder and pre-create the vendor tenant.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Grant
Security & Compliance Lead
Medsys Health

Attachments: vendor_audit_req.pdf
